name: Son La
provinceNote: 2026 pages still print Sơn La province. From 1 July 2025, phường Tô Hiệu is the merged center and includes old phường Chiềng Lề. A May 2025 walking-street notice still prints thành phố Sơn La and the wards Chiềng Cơi and Quyết Thắng. A May 2026 line prints phường Chiềng Cơi, tỉnh Sơn La, without the words thành phố. The 2020 handbook still prints thành phố Sơn La. Both the city wording and the 2025 ward wording stay.
dotReason: Worth a special trip in this corridor
summary: The valley town under Khau Ca sits on Highway 6 past the Moc Chau tea plateau. Stay if that night is the trip. Sleep in Moc Chau if you wanted the tea morning, and do not drive on to Dien Bien the same day. Prison clocks and tickets do not agree, so check the gate on arrival.
timeNeeded: One night, or two if the dam is next
getThere: Highway 6 west of Moc Chau. Hanoi is about 300 km.
seoTitle: Son La travel guide — Highway 6 valley past Moc Chau
seoDescription: Sleep under Khau Ca, the valley town west of the Moc Chau tea plateau on Highway 6. Dry months are October to April. Prison hours and the dam distance disagree.
intro: You come down into a bowl of roofs, with the stone walls of the old prison on Khau Ca and the Nam La in the valley. The ridges sit behind the hill. Stay if that night is the trip. Sleep in Moc Chau if you wanted the tea rows on the plateau before this city. Do not drive on to Dien Bien the same day when the hill over the town is the reason you stopped.

The bed is a small hotel or guesthouse in the town center. From 1 July 2025 that center is phường Tô Hiệu, the old Chiềng Lề market street. The other bed is a Thái stilt house at Bản Mòng, xã Hua La, on the edge of the city. No hotel is a pick. Two Saturday nights a month, Hoàng Quốc Việt is a walking street from 19:30 to 23:00, from the Highway 6 junction to the turn into bản Mé Ban. Which two Saturdays in a given month are check on arrival. On the other nights a bar street was not named, so the ordinary evening address is check on arrival.

Give the morning to the central market, then the climb to Khau Ca for the prison and the museum beside it. About one hour for the prison and about one hour for the museum, on one split. Late afternoon, the Lê Thái Tông temple looks back over the stream. Bản Mòng is the other half of the day, or the night in the stilt house. The dam on the Đà is a separate morning, north on Highway 279. The mistake is treating the museum ticket and the relic ticket as one price, or budgeting the whole day for a hill that sits in town.
gettingAround: The usual start is Hanoi, and the road is National Highway 6. The 2020 handbook says more than 300 km. The prison page says about 300 km. The 2026 coach decision prints 300 km to Mỹ Đình and 293 km to Yên Nghĩa, two different Hanoi stations. Keep every figure. The 2020 handbook’s overnight coach leaves Mỹ Đình about 19:00–20:00 and reaches Sơn La about 7:00–8:00, about 7–8 hours. A reservoir page also prints a coach of 7–8 hours, and a car of 6–7 hours for the road through this city and on to Mường La, which is not a pure city-center time. The 2026 decision lists clocks and prints no duration, so it does not replace those older hours. The fare is check on arrival.

Departures listed from Sơn La on that 2026 decision are 5:45, 8:15, 20:30, 22:15, and 23:30. Return clocks from Mỹ Đình are 18:30, 23:45, 12:45, 20:00, and 16:00. The operator is Công ty cổ phần vận tải hành khách 2-9 Sơn La. The decision is 166/QĐ-SXD of 29 April 2026. Điện Biên coaches also pass the city and often arrive at night, on the 2020 handbook.

The maintained Highway 6 section Km193+000–Km303+000 is 110 km, described in 2017 as huyện Mộc Châu to thành phố Sơn La. That is a project length. Two commercial pages put the center-to-center drive at about 140 km and at more than 140 km, with about 3 hours or more than 3 hours by car and about 5 hours or nearly 5 hours by motorbike. Keep the 110 km section and the longer center-to-center figures. A road-authority minute count for this leg is check on arrival. The 2017 chairman’s line, that the upgrade cut Hòa Bình–Sơn La time by nearly one hour, is not a 2026 minute count.

Noi Bai in Hanoi is the airport travelers actually use. The handbook sends southern visitors to Hanoi by air and then by road. Nà Sản, in xã Chiềng Mung and Mai Sơn, is in the national airport plan and is not a 2026 passenger service. Do not book a flight into it. No rail station is named for this city.

In town, Highway 6 is the street the coaches use through the valley. Highway 279 leaves north for Mường La and the dam. The prison is a walk up Khau Ca from the center. A taxi fare inside town, a city bus map, and a motorbike hire price are check on arrival. Bản Mòng is a paved road to Hua La. The commune page says nearly 6 km, the national tourism desk about 5 km, and the handbook and a tourism-organization page about 7 km. Minutes on that road are check on arrival.

West, Highway 6 climbs Pha Đin toward Điện Biên. The pass itself is 32 km on both pages that measure it. The Điện Biên relic board says the pass starts 66 km west of Sơn La town and ends about 84 km from Điện Biên city, at more than 1,000 m. Another page prints a summit of 1,648 m, 65 km from Sơn La, and 80 km from Điện Biên Phủ. Keep both pairs, and keep more than 1,000 m beside 1,648 m. Minutes are check on arrival. Yên Châu is the district town on this highway between Mộc Châu and the city. Kilometers for Yên Châu are check on arrival. Hòa Bình is the city on the coach road toward Hanoi. Minutes from here are check on arrival. Mai Châu is the valley before the plateau. A kilometer from this city was not printed, so that leg is check on arrival. Tà Xùa is a cloud ridge in the province. The road from this city is check on arrival.

stayAreas.name: Town center
stayAreas.summary: Small hotels and guesthouses on the old Chiềng Lề market street, inside phường Tô Hiệu from 1 July 2025. This is the bed under Khau Ca, a walk from the hill. No hotel is a pick. A room rate is check on arrival.

stayAreas.name: Ban Mong
stayAreas.summary: Thái stilt houses at Bản Mòng, xã Hua La, on the edge of the city. The spring and the lane are the reason to sleep here. The distance is about 5 km, nearly 6 km, or about 7 km, depending on the page. A room rate and a soak price are check on arrival.

eat: The meal at a Thái hearth is pa pỉnh tộp, hearth-smoked buffalo, cơm lam, and rượu cần, at Bản Mòng or in town. The handbook says the fish is split along the back, stuffed with ginger, lemongrass, and mắc khén, then grilled and eaten with sticky rice. The national desk adds chẩm chéo, roasted salt, grilled chili, mắc khén, garlic, and herbs. Stall prices are check on arrival.

Hearth-smoked buffalo is seasoned with forest chili, pepper, and mắc khén, black outside and still red inside. Bản Mòng’s menus call the same family thịt hun khói. Eat it with rice and rượu cần, or carry it because the handbook lists it as a gift that keeps. A drying time is check on arrival. Cơm lam is sticky rice in a bamboo tube, closed with banana leaf or fresh leaf, then heated on a wood fire. Eat it from the tube with the fish or the smoked meat. Rượu cần is the jar on the Bản Mòng floor, through the pipes, with the meal and the xòe. A strength and a price are check on arrival.

Nậm pịa is a Thái offal dish the handbook sets from cow or goat blood, with tail, stomach, and the base of the heart, plus the thick liquid from the small intestine, cooked until it tightens. Eat it hot with banana flower and mint. The handbook calls it an acquired taste. A shop that posts it every day is check on arrival. Thịt chua người Dao is belly pork, scored, salted, packed with leftover rice, and soured in a jar, eaten with lá lốt at Tết and for guests. A souring time is check on arrival. Bê chao, in one handbook sentence, is sliced calf seasoned with ginger, lemongrass, and pepper and passed through hot oil. Forest vegetables, and ban flower stir-fried with sour bamboo, sit beside the Bản Mòng grill.

Chợ Trung tâm is the daily hall on the old Chiềng Lề street, now inside phường Tô Hiệu. A 2024 trade list puts it at 8,940 m², hạng 2. Chợ 7-11, in phường Quyết Thắng, is the other hạng 2 daily market, at 6,615 m². What is on the breakfast plate, and both clocks, are check on arrival. The Saturday stalls on Hoàng Quốc Việt run only on the walking-street nights, 19:30–23:00. Other nights that street is an ordinary road.
interestsBody: The night is the valley under Khau Ca. The prison hill, the Đà River dam, Bản Mòng’s spring, and the poem on the cave wall are the reasons the day splits the way it does.
Saturday xòe on Hoàng Quốc Việt is two nights a month. The old market street is the morning. Pha Đin is the wall on the road west.

interestGroups.title: The prison on Khau Ca
interestGroups.summary: For the stone walls on the hill over town, when the valley night is the reason you stopped.

cards.title: The prison on Khau Ca
cards.summary: Walk the French prison on the hill, then the provincial museum beside it. The clocks and the tickets do not agree.

body: The prison stands on Khau Ca, in phường Tô Hiệu after 1 July 2025. Older pages still print tổ 9, phường Tô Hiệu, thành phố Sơn La. You walk stone walls, four watchtowers, ground-floor and underground cells, a cistern, the cemetery and Tô Hiệu’s grave, and the peach tree he planted. Much of the original building is a ruin after the bombings of 1952 and 1965, with some rebuilt sections and labels. It was built in 1908 and enlarged through the 1930s and 1940s, from more than 1,200 m² to about 2,184 m², with walls up to 4.5 m. It was ranked a special national relic by Quyết định 2408/QĐ-TTg on 31 December 2014. Morning, before the stone yard is hot, is the easier hour. Around Tết the peach tree is the picture people come for. The blossom week moves, so that week is check on arrival.

GoVietnam prints about 7:30–17:30 with a midday break, and about one hour for the prison plus about one hour if the museum is included. Mytour prints 7:30–18:30. A page that describes the museum, not the relic gate, prints a split day, 7:30–11:30 and 13:30–17:30. Keep every clock. GoVietnam and Mytour both print 30,000 VND for an adult, 15,000 VND for a person over 60, and 5,000 VND for a student. GoVietnam also puts disabled visitors on the 15,000 VND line. Mytour puts wounded veterans and people over 60 on that line, and limits the 30,000 VND ticket to adults under 60. The museum page prints 10,000 VND from age 16, 5,000 VND from 10 to under 16, and free under 10. Whether one ticket covers both buildings is check on arrival. The gate on the day is check on arrival.

The museum is on the same hill, đường Khau Cả, beside the prison. The 2020 handbook says the displays are the ethnic collection: prehistoric objects and more than 1,000 ancient Thái and Dao books. Another page names Thái, Mông, and Dao material, old Thái script, and village life, and a travel page prints more than 23,000 objects and three galleries. The book count and the object count are different counts. Keep both. Rừng Vàng, in phường Chiềng Sinh, is a green patch with bamboo near the center. No trail length and no ticket were printed. It is not the reason for the night. Check on arrival.

interestGroups.title: The Da River dam
interestGroups.summary: For the half-day north of town, when you can live with two distances and two visit rules.

cards.title: The Da River dam
cards.summary: Look at the dam from the public side, then stop on Pá Uôn if the lake road is the day.

body: The plant is at Ít Ong, Mường La, on the Đà, not in the town center. EVN inaugurated it on 23 December 2012. Installed capacity is 2,400 MW, six units of 400 MW. The reservoir is 9.26 billion m³. Normal level 215 m, surcharge 217.83 m, dead water 175 m. The gravity dam is 138.1 m high, with a crest of 961.6 m. A second EVN page adds crest elevation 228.1 m, base width 105 m, and crest width 10 m. One reservoir page prints a lake surface of 224 km² at design level. The EVN release does not print that surface, so 224 km² stays as that one page’s figure. The museum handbook and that reservoir page put the dam about 40 km and about one hour north of the city. sonlatour.vn prints about 60 km from the city center. Keep about 40 km and about 60 km. Minutes for the 60 km figure are check on arrival. The one-hour figure belongs to the 40 km account.

The reservoir page says viewing from outside is free, for about 30–45 minutes, and that the plant below the dam is closed. Boat tours on that page run 7:00–17:00. A 2026 note says visitors should register before a plant visit, that a visit takes about 2–3 hours, and that the cost is free or very low. Those visit rules disagree. A current gate tariff is check on arrival. A boat fee is check on arrival. GoVietnam names October–April as the dry months for this lake, and suggests early morning or late afternoon for the viewpoint. That season is one page.

Pá Uôn is the bridge on the reservoir road toward Điện Biên, after Mường La. The handbook places it at xã Chiềng Ơn, beside thị trấn Phiêng Lanh, and says the height from the ground to the deck is 105 m and the middle span reaches 120 m. The reservoir page says the bridge was built in 2010, is 918 m long, and that the deck is 100 m above the lake, and places it about 60 km northwest of the dam. Keep 100 m above the lake, 105 m from the ground to the deck, and 120 m for the middle span. They are not one measurement. The 918 m length is one page. A stop is about 30 minutes on that reservoir page. A bridge ticket was not printed, so the fee is check on arrival. Do not add the dam’s 60 km city disagreement onto that 60 km from the dam and call it one city distance.

The lakeside temples at Quỳnh Nhai are a different stop from the bridge and from the Lê temple in town. A February 2025 report says the spiritual ground is still being finished, on a plan of nearly 20 ha. Đền Nàng Han and Đền Linh Sơn Thủy Từ were rebuilt from shrines of the 17th century. A Quan Âm statue, finished at the end of 2020, is 32 m, back to the limestone and face to the Đà. The same report describes it as a first-month incense stop. A time, a fee, and a 2027 festival calendar are check on arrival.

interestGroups.title: The hot-spring hamlet
interestGroups.summary: For Bản Mòng’s spring and a Thái stilt house, on the edge of the city.

cards.title: The hot-spring hamlet
cards.summary: Soak at Bó Nặm Ún, then eat in a Thái stilt house. The distance depends on which page you read.

body: Bản Mòng is in xã Hua La, on the city edge. The commune page says nearly 6 km, the national tourism desk about 5 km, and the handbook and a tourism-organization page about 7 km. Keep all three. Minutes are check on arrival. The soak is the hot spring Bó Nặm Ún, then a meal in a Thái stilt house. More than 106 Thái households live here, with wet rice, livestock, and brocade. The city and the hamlet have run community visits since 1997. A soak price was not printed. The fee is check on arrival.

The commune page says the water is a stable 36–38°C, with no smell, and that people come in any month. The national tourism desk says the outdoor average is 38°C and that the water changes with the season, milder in summer and hotter in winter. The tourism-organization page says 36–38°C and about 7 km. Keep the stable band and the seasonal line. Do not collapse them into one season. The sight is the spring and the stilt lane.

interestGroups.title: The king's poem
interestGroups.summary: For the Quế Lâm poem at the cave mouth, and the view over the Nam La.

cards.title: The king's poem
cards.summary: Read the 1440 poem on the rock, then the later temple above the stream.

body: King Lê Thái Tông cut the Quế Lâm poem into the rock at the cave mouth in the fifth lunar month of 1440, after a campaign in the Northwest. The handbook calls the cave động La, and the local name Thẩm Ké. A 2025 report calls the same rock hang Thẳm Báo Ké and says the temple above it looks over the city and suối Nặm La. A festival page says the temple beside the stele was built in 2001. The poem, the cave mouth, and the later temple are one stop. The handbook and a festival page print phường Chiềng Lề. From 1 July 2025 that ward is part of phường Tô Hiệu. Under an hour covers the stele and the view. Walking minutes from the market are check on arrival. No gate tariff was printed. The fee is check on arrival.

Two festival pages disagree on the gathering. One prints 15–17 of the first lunar month. The other prints 15–17 in the header and 22–24 of the first lunar month in the body, and says the first city edition fell on 15–17 of the first lunar month in 2016. Keep both windows. The civil dates for 2027 are check on arrival. Late afternoon is the hour for the view. The first lunar month is the hour if the festival window is the reason. This is not a pagoda on the Mộc Châu plateau, and it is not the lakeside temples at Quỳnh Nhai.

interestGroups.title: Saturday xoe on Hoang Quoc Viet
interestGroups.summary: For the city’s walking street, two Saturday nights a month, from 19:30.

cards.title: Saturday xoe on Hoang Quoc Viet
cards.summary: Walk the street when the calendar hits a Saturday night. Do not expect the same scene on a weeknight.

body: Hoàng Quốc Việt runs from the Highway 6 junction to the turn into bản Mé Ban, in phường Chiềng Cơi and phường Quyết Thắng. Twice a month, on Saturday, it is closed to traffic from 19:30 to 23:00. The night is xòe, club music, folk games, and food stalls. A May 2026 report still describes that twice-a-month Saturday night. Which two Saturdays the city will post is check on arrival. The city says the theme calendar goes on the city portal. No entry fee was printed. Stall prices are check on arrival.
This is not the Mộc Châu night market, and it is not a bar street. No bar was named. On the other nights the hour the town goes quiet is check on arrival. A cafe street was not named.

interestGroups.title: The old market street
interestGroups.summary: For the morning hall on the old Chiềng Lề street, and the brocade the handbook lists to take home.

cards.title: The old market street
cards.summary: Start at Chợ Trung tâm. The clock inside the hall is check on arrival.

body: Chợ Trung tâm is the city’s main market, a solid hall, hạng 2, meeting daily, at 8,940 m² in the 2024 trade list. That list puts it at tổ 12, phường Chiềng Lề. From 1 July 2025 that ward is part of phường Tô Hiệu. Both addresses stay. The clock, and what is on the breakfast plate, are check on arrival. Chợ 7-11 is the other hạng 2 daily market, at tổ 8, phường Quyết Thắng, 6,615 m². A dish list for that hall was not printed. Its clock is check on arrival.

The handbook’s gift list for a highland market is brocade, a Mông knife, and smoked meat. There is no mall in that list. Chợ đầu mối nông sản Chiềng Cơi, at bản Mé Ban, is a wholesale produce market of 1,370 m² where the walking street ends. It is not the visitor meal.

interestGroups.title: The pass west
interestGroups.summary: For the view on Pha Đin, on the way toward Điện Biên, on a clear day.

cards.title: The pass west
cards.summary: Stop at the top of the pass. The summit figures do not agree, and the fee is check on arrival.

body: Pha Đin Top is an operating provincial point for the view and the clouds, in xã Bình Thuận, on Highway 6 west of the city. The pass itself is 32 km. The Điện Biên relic board says it starts 66 km west of Sơn La town and ends about 84 km from Điện Biên city, at more than 1,000 m. Another page prints a summit of 1,648 m, 65 km from Sơn La, and 80 km from Điện Biên Phủ. Keep 66 km and 65 km, and 84 km and 80 km, and keep more than 1,000 m beside 1,648 m. A path length inside the tourism point is check on arrival. No tariff was on the open-data row. The fee is check on arrival. Minutes from town are check on arrival.

A clear day is the hour. One page names thick fog in December–February and says to avoid the heavy rain of June–August. A closure calendar is check on arrival. The city beyond the pass is the next overnight. This stop is the Sơn La edge of that road.

faqs.a: Moc Chau is the tea plateau on Highway 6 before this city. Son La is the valley town after it, under Khau Ca. A tea-row morning is the plateau. The prison hill over the Nam La is this night.

faqs.q: How long is the road from Hanoi?
faqs.a: The handbook says more than 300 km. The prison page says about 300 km. The 2026 coach decision prints 300 km to Mỹ Đình and 293 km to Yên Nghĩa. The 2020 overnight run is about 7–8 hours. A reservoir page also prints a coach of 7–8 hours, and a car of 6–7 hours on the road that continues to the dam. The 2026 decision prints clocks and no duration. The fare is check on arrival.

faqs.q: What time does the prison open, and what is the ticket?
faqs.a: GoVietnam prints about 7:30–17:30 with a midday break. Mytour prints 7:30–18:30. A museum page prints 7:30–11:30 and 13:30–17:30. GoVietnam and Mytour print 30,000 VND, 15,000 VND, and 5,000 VND, and they do not describe the 15,000 VND line the same way. The museum page prints 10,000 VND from age 16, 5,000 VND from 10 to under 16, and free under 10. The gate on the day is check on arrival.

faqs.q: When is the Le temple festival?
faqs.a: One festival page prints 15–17 of the first lunar month. Another prints 15–17 in the header and 22–24 of the first lunar month in the body. The first city edition, on that second page, fell on 15–17 of the first lunar month in 2016. The civil dates for 2027 are check on arrival. The fee is check on arrival.

season.label: Dry road from October to April
season.note: A reservoir page calls October–April the dry months and May–September the rain, and it prints 10–18°C for November–January at the lake. That temperature is one page, not a city weather station. The same publisher’s pass page names thick fog on Pha Đin in December–February and tells drivers to avoid June–August rain. A pass-closure calendar is check on arrival. The Tô Hiệu peach flowers around Tết, and the civil dates move. The Lê temple gathering is 15–17 or 22–24 of the first lunar month, and the 2027 dates are check on arrival. The 2020 handbook names September for Hmong independence days and does not name a day.
